#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

today="2025-08-12"
today_ts=$(date -d "$today" +%s)
last7_start=$(date -d "$today -6 days" +%Y-%m-%d)
last7_start_ts=$(date -d "$last7_start" +%s)
last30_start=$(date -d "$today -29 days" +%Y-%m-%d)
last30_start_ts=$(date -d "$last30_start" +%s)
month_start=$(date -d "$today" +%Y-%m-01)
month_start_ts=$(date -d "$month_start" +%s)

declare -A today_counts total_counts last7_counts last30_counts month_counts
for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do
  today_counts[$sev]=0
  total_counts[$sev]=0
  last7_counts[$sev]=0
  last30_counts[$sev]=0
  month_counts[$sev]=0
done

shopt -s nullglob
for f in /app/logs/*.log; do
  filename=$(basename "$f")
  date_part=${filename%%_*}
  file_ts=$(date -d "$date_part" +%s || continue)

  # get counts in file
  declare -A file_counts
  for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do file_counts[$sev]=0; done
  while read -r count sev; do
    file_counts[$sev]=$count
  done < <(grep -o -E 'ERROR|WARNING|INFO' "$f" | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $1,$2}')

  # update total
  for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do
    total_counts[$sev]=$(( total_counts[$sev] + file_counts[$sev] ))
  done

  # check periods
  if (( file_ts == today_ts )); then
    for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do
      today_counts[$sev]=$(( today_counts[$sev] + file_counts[$sev] ))
    done
  fi
  if (( file_ts >= last7_start_ts && file_ts <= today_ts )); then
    for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do
      last7_counts[$sev]=$(( last7_counts[$sev] + file_counts[$sev] ))
    done
  fi
  if (( file_ts >= last30_start_ts && file_ts <= today_ts )); then
    for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do
      last30_counts[$sev]=$(( last30_counts[$sev] + file_counts[$sev] ))
    done
  fi
  if (( file_ts >= month_start_ts && file_ts <= today_ts )); then
    for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do
      month_counts[$sev]=$(( month_counts[$sev] + file_counts[$sev] ))
    done
  fi
done

{
echo "period,severity,count"
for period in today last_7_days last_30_days month_to_date total; do
  case $period in
    today) arr=(${!today_counts[@]});;
    last_7_days) arr=(${!last7_counts[@]});;
    last_30_days) arr=(${!last30_counts[@]});;
    month_to_date) arr=(${!month_counts[@]});;
    total) arr=(${!total_counts[@]});;
  esac

      last_7_days) cnt=${last7_counts[$sev]};;
      last_30_days) cnt=${last30_counts[$sev]};;
      month_to_date) cnt=${month_counts[$sev]};;
      total) cnt=${total_counts[$sev]};;
    esac
    echo "$period,$sev,$cnt"
  done
done
} > /app/summary.csv
